ns2:course.label: Advanced Topics in Advertising
ns2:course.description: This seminar explores topics associated with advertising theory and research. Topics will vary across different course offerings. They will include classic elements of advertising theory (e.g. persuasion, attitudes, cognition, emotion, motivation), as well as current research frontiers (e.g. decision-making, computational advertising, psychophysiology, gaming, social media). 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated up to 12 hours, if topics vary. Prerequisite: Ph.D. student or instructor approval.
